abstract: When the writer of the book of Ecclesiastes said that “there is nothing new under the sun,” he (or she) had clearly never considered the 21 st -century media and entertainment industry. Of course, I say that in jest. But frivolity aside, there is most definitely something new every day under our SMPTE sun! It is for that reason that I am thrilled to present this issue on a theme we call “The Cutting Edge.”
